kpis.title: First Loss Prevention Colloquium
kpis.description: IVR organized its inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, bringing together 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland shipping. Eight presentations covered topics including collision prevention, safety culture, decarbonization impacts, hull damage trends, and clean shipping solutions. The event was moderated by Ronald Koops, chair of the IVR Loss Prevention Committee, emphasizing the importance of collaboration and knowledge exchange in a rapidly evolving sector focused on sustainability and technical innovation.

kpis.title: Successful Frankfurt Congress 2024
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Annual Congress held May 15-17 in Frankfurt attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries. The congress featured a workshop on 'Navigating into the future, the value and versatility of inland waterways' with presentations on vessel safety, legal frameworks, sustainability, and clean shipping solutions. The general assembly took place aboard the Maria Sibylla Merian, where General Secretary Frouwke de Vries reviewed IVR activities including collaboration with ZKR and European Commission, focus on emissions and climate change, and ongoing projects. The event concluded with networking activities and dinners.

company_description: Edenred SE operates as a digital platform for services and payments for companies, employees, and merchants worldwide. It offers employee benefit solutions, including Ticket Restaurant, a solution that allows employees to take time out for lunch at a partner merchant; Ticket Alimentación, which allows users to pay for groceries in stores and supermarkets; Edenred Regalo, a gift voucher; Ticket CESU, a human services solution; Edenred City, a solution that enables the purchase of staples, such as food and fuel; Welfare Edenred, which employees can use to pay for various services, including access to sports facilities and solutions for their children's educational needs; Edenred Eco, a solution that encourages the purchase of environmentally friendly products in Belgium; and Kadéos Culture in France and Ticket Cultura in Brazil for cultural goods and services, as well as mobility solutions through Edenred Mobility.
